name: Ryan Detrick, CMT
zh_summary: @RyanDetrick says his contrarian call that the 9.1% Feb/March correction would be the year's largest pullback is holding, despite bulls cutting targets in July. This may be the earliest max peak to trough correction in a midterm year since 1958.
en_summary: @RyanDetrick says his contrarian call that the 9.1% Feb/March correction would be the year's largest pullback is holding, despite bulls cutting targets in July. This may be the earliest max peak to trough correction in a midterm year since 1958.
text:
One of our more contrarian calls was the 9.1% mild correction we saw in Feb/March would be the largest pullback of the year. We started to say that back in May and this wasn't a popular call. 

In July, many bulls were cutting their targets and calling for a bear market in Q3. The reasoning was midterm years tend to see the largest corrections.

This could now be the earliest max peak-to-trough correction in a midterm year since 1958.

name: Charlie Bilello
zh_summary: @charliebilello lists Trump quotes: promising to halve energy prices within 12 to 18 months, to stop wars, to put America first, calling the Strait of Hormuz American territory (Aug 2026), and saying oil and gasoline would fall below $2 a gallon after the election (Sept 2026).
en_summary: @charliebilello lists Trump quotes: promising to halve energy prices within 12 to 18 months, to stop wars, to put America first, calling the Strait of Hormuz American territory (Aug 2026), and saying oil and gasoline would fall below $2 a gallon after the election (Sept 2026).
text:
“Under my administration, we will be slashing energy and electricity prices by half within 12 months, at a maximum 18 months.” - President Trump, August 2024      

“I’m not going to start a war. I’m going to stop wars.” - President Trump, November 2024

"During every single day of the administration, I will, very simply, put America first." - President Trump, January 2025

"I view the Strait of Hormuz as an American territory right now. It’s an American territory." - President Trump, August 2026

"Right after the election, oil prices are going to be tumbling downward and for gasoline, we'll get 'em below $2 a gallon." - President Trump, September 2026
